## 1. Physical Wavefront Formulation
A holographic projection system reconstructs a full 3D optical wavefront $U(x, y, z)$ by recording and modulating both amplitude and phase interference between an object wave $U_{\text{obj}}(x, y) = A_o(x, y) e^{i \phi_o(x, y)}$ and a coherent reference laser beam $U_{\text{ref}}(x, y) = A_r e^{i k \sin(\theta) x}$:

$$I(x, y) = |U_{\text{obj}} + U_{\text{ref}}|^2 = |A_o|^2 + |A_r|^2 + U_{\text{obj}} U_{\text{ref}}^* + U_{\text{obj}}^* U_{\text{ref}}$$

## 2. Fresnel Diffraction & Spatial Light Modulation (SLM)
To project a dynamic 3D field at distance $z$, the phase-only Spatial Light Modulator (SLM) computes the inverse Fresnel-Kirchhoff propagation integral:

$$U(x', y', z) = \frac{e^{i k z}}{i \lambda z} \iint U(x, y, 0) \exp\left\{ \frac{i k}{2 z} \left[(x' - x)^2 + (y' - y)^2\right] \right\} dx\,dy$$
